input.summary: Jordan Doe's credentials (jdoe@example.com) were used to attack the payments-prod clusters on EKS, GKE and AKS, one after another. All of the activity came from 198.51.100.23, a bulletproof VPS host on threat feeds (NIGHTOWL-HOSTING, NL) that also runs an open Docker registry on port 5000. The client was kubectl on Linux, but Jordan normally uses macOS and is on PTO from 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-19. The same steps ran on every cluster (EKS 14:02, GKE 14:38, AKS 15:11).
